    • isOutOfRenderRange

      default boolean isOutOfRenderRange(Location origin, Location other)
      Checks whether two locations are too far apart to render a preview. Locations in different worlds are always out of range.
      Parameters:
      origin - the first location
      other - the second location
      Returns:
      true if the locations are in different worlds or further apart than renderDistance()
